run_data_processor_cli: run the ATIS data processor CLI to convert raw intent, slot, and query CSVs into processed train, validation, and test files
process_train_set: process the ATIS training data CSVs into tab-separated train and validation split files using provided vocabularies
process_test_set: process the ATIS test data CSVs into a tab-separated test file using provided intent, slot, and word vocabularies
read_vocab: read a vocabulary file and return a dictionary mapping line indices to stripped word strings
stringify: convert a space-separated numericalized sentence into a list of words with their character start and end indices using a vocab
